title: The local lint gate runs code-check and zizmor, as CI does
why: Incidents, Oct 28: batch 7 (#763) went red on code-check's ruff F541 in c166's merge/test_merge.py, and batch 6 dropped c168 on a zizmor red; in both, the lane's and the orchestrator's local `bin/ci-job gates --lint --base origin/main` had passed.
note: Debt, same class as c172. Measured by triage 10 on main 599dd58b: `ci-job gates --lint --plan` lists neither the Code check step (a `uses: ./actions/code-check` action) nor the zizmor step (`pipx run zizmor`), since --lint keeps only `python3 lint|actions/...` and bin/ste-changed lines and drops the rest silently. Next cloud lane: --lint runs actions/code-check the way it already runs ste-lint (one home: code_check.py with the --base, on changed files), and runs the zizmor step; a lint-class step it cannot run prints unknown, never nothing. Red first: today's --lint over a planted F541 and a planted zizmor finding passes. Touches bin/ci-job and its tests. Needs no answer. Port: yes, every repo that calls code-check. Placed ahead of c95 and every other cleanup step (triage 10, Oct 28; orchestrator's ask): two batches in a row lost a 50 to 60 min CI run to it. Doing: lane started Oct 28 (session_013NEJKzNQLsaUKaaJp9Fpyz). Builder running. Cloud note: pipx is absent in the container; the lane installed it with pip install --user pipx so --lint can run CI's pinned tools.
